name: Beyond You!
source:
It's your last year of high school, and you're about to make a big decision for your future... Who will you choose to be your lab partner?!

There's Haruka, the fiery runner! Aiko, the intelligent leader! Kana, the silly sweetheart! And Yumi, the mute snarker! And don't forget you! There's no one else beyond you, after all.

It's all on you!

[From [url=https://hexvexed.itch.io/beyond-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是你高中的最后一年，你即将为你的未来做出重大决定……你会选择谁作为你的实验室伙伴？！

火热的跑步者Haruka来了！爱子，聪明的领导者！卡娜，傻甜心！还有由美，那个沉默的嘲讽者！并且不要忘记你！毕竟除了你之外没有其他人了。

这一切都取决于你！

[来自[url=https://hexvexed.itch.io/beyond-you]itch.io[/url]]
